result.title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
result.summary: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究自改进 GUI agent 如何利用自身轨迹经验，提出问题在于「经验单元」粒度：把轨迹拆成 locator、procedure、state fact、lesson 四类组件，分别路由到上下文或权重，并用「复现性」和「状态条件性」两个训练前可测属性拟合路由规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉 latent reasoning 工作，但其「同一经验池因组件属性不同而适合不同去向」的问题表述，可能与 LVR 中 latent 内容应写入权重还是保留在上下文/状态、以及按内容类型筛选视觉证据与监督信号的思路相呼应，可供核查。
